commands.name: export_project
commands.description: Requests an export through PageRivet's existing Export workflow. The request follows the active MCP approval policy, while validation errors still block execution. A one-time configuration is never saved as a user preset.

commands.name: get_application_info
commands.description: Returns PageRivet application capabilities and runtime information. This tool never changes editor state.

commands.name: get_export_presets
commands.description: Returns every built-in and user export preset plus the active project's selected preset. It never modifies or selects a preset.

commands.name: get_mcp_log
commands.description: Returns recent PageRivet MCP activity log entries with authentication values and machine-specific data redacted.

commands.name: get_mcp_status
commands.description: Returns the current MCP server, transport, port, approval-policy, authentication-presence, and Claude Desktop bridge state. Secret values are never returned.

commands.name: get_preview_state
commands.description: Returns Preview initialization and current-page state without changing Preview or project data.

commands.name: get_recovery_status
commands.description: Returns read-only Recovery availability and recoverable snapshot metadata. It never returns recovery source content or a machine path.

commands.name: get_ui_state
commands.description: Returns the current PageRivet language, theme, and high-level UI operation state without changing user settings.

commands.name: preview_html_page
commands.description: Shows one existing project-relative HTML page in Preview without changing project files or layout settings.

commands.name: refresh_preview
commands.description: Refreshes the active project's current Preview page without modifying project files or UI settings.

commands.name: save_project
commands.description: Saves only the validated, already-applied state of the active project. It never applies pending editor text, changes project, or performs Save As.

commands.name: get_project_files
commands.description: Lists every project-relative HTML, CSS, JavaScript, YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, and TypeScript source of the active project with size and SHA-256 metadata.

commands.name: get_project_info
commands.description: Returns metadata and revision state for the single active PageRivet project. It cannot access any other directory.

commands.name: get_project_resources
commands.description: Lists every managed resource in the active project with its project-relative path, resource kind, media type, byte size, and all supported extensions. It never reads outside the active project.

commands.name: read_css
commands.description: Reads the applied style.css source from the active project. Unapplied editor text is reported but is not returned as applied code.

commands.name: read_css_file
commands.description: Reads one applied project-relative CSS file from the active project by path.

commands.name: read_html
commands.description: Reads the applied index.html source from the active project. Unapplied editor text is reported but is not returned as applied code.

commands.name: read_html_page
commands.description: Reads one applied project-relative HTML page from the active project by path. Unapplied editor text is reported but is not returned as applied code.

commands.name: read_javascript
commands.description: Reads the applied script.js source from the active project. Unapplied editor text is reported but is not returned as applied code.

commands.name: read_javascript_file
commands.description: Reads one applied project-relative JavaScript file from the active project by path.

commands.name: read_text_resource
commands.description: Reads one supported UTF-8 text resource from the active project's managed assets. Supported editable formats are JSON, XML, CSV, WebVTT, text, Markdown, web manifest, source map, glTF JSON, and SVG.

commands.name: read_text_source
commands.description: Reads one applied project-relative YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, or TypeScript source from the active project by path.

commands.name: create_css_file
commands.description: Creates one new project-relative CSS file. The required style.css file already exists and cannot be recreated.

commands.name: create_html_page
commands.description: Creates one new project-relative HTML page in the active project. PageRivet validates the complete project and follows its write approval policy before applying anything.

commands.name: create_javascript_file
commands.description: Creates one new project-relative JavaScript file. The required script.js file already exists and cannot be recreated.

commands.name: create_text_resource
commands.description: Creates one supported UTF-8 text resource in the active project's managed assets after applying PageRivet's write approval policy. JSON, XML, WebVTT, SVG, and JSON-based formats are syntax-validated before approval and again before writing.

commands.name: create_text_source
commands.description: Creates one project-relative YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, or TypeScript source after applying PageRivet's write approval policy.

commands.name: import_project_resource
commands.description: Imports one supported local file into the active project's managed assets folder after PageRivet approval. The exact local source path is shown to the user before access is granted.

commands.name: apply_css_file_patch
commands.description: Submits minimal exact-text replacements for one existing project-relative CSS file, including style.css.

commands.name: apply_css_patch
commands.description: Submits minimal exact-text replacements for style.css. PageRivet validates the complete project and requires approval in its own UI before applying anything.

commands.name: apply_html_page_patch
commands.description: Submits minimal exact-text replacements for one existing project-relative HTML page, including index.html. PageRivet validates the complete project and follows its write approval policy before applying anything.

commands.name: apply_html_patch
commands.description: Submits minimal exact-text replacements for index.html. PageRivet validates the complete project and requires approval in its own UI before applying anything.

commands.name: apply_javascript_file_patch
commands.description: Submits minimal exact-text replacements for one existing project-relative JavaScript file, including script.js.

commands.name: apply_javascript_patch
commands.description: Submits minimal exact-text replacements for script.js. PageRivet validates the complete project and requires approval in its own UI before applying anything.

commands.name: apply_project_patch
commands.description: Submits one atomic patch spanning any existing project-relative HTML, CSS, JavaScript, YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, and/or TypeScript sources. Use this when one requested change spans multiple files.

commands.name: apply_text_resource_patch
commands.description: Submits ordered exact-text replacements for one existing managed UTF-8 text resource. PageRivet validates supported structured formats and applies the approved change atomically.

commands.name: apply_text_source_patch
commands.description: Submits ordered exact-text replacements for one existing project-relative YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, or TypeScript source.

commands.name: delete_css_file
commands.description: Deletes one project-relative CSS file. The required style.css file cannot be deleted.

commands.name: delete_html_page
commands.description: Deletes one existing project-relative HTML page. The required index.html entry page cannot be deleted. PageRivet follows its write approval policy before applying anything.

commands.name: delete_javascript_file
commands.description: Deletes one project-relative JavaScript file. The required script.js file cannot be deleted.

commands.name: delete_project_resource
commands.description: Deletes one managed project resource after applying PageRivet's write approval policy.

commands.name: delete_text_source
commands.description: Deletes one project-relative YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, or TypeScript source.

commands.name: rename_css_file
commands.description: Renames one project-relative CSS file. The required style.css file cannot be renamed.

commands.name: rename_html_page
commands.description: Renames one existing project-relative HTML page. The required index.html entry page cannot be renamed. PageRivet follows its write approval policy before applying anything.

commands.name: rename_javascript_file
commands.description: Renames one project-relative JavaScript file. The required script.js file cannot be renamed.

commands.name: rename_project_resource
commands.description: Renames one managed project resource without changing its resource kind, after applying PageRivet's write approval policy.

commands.name: rename_text_source
commands.description: Renames one project-relative YAML, Markdown, SCSS, MJS, or TypeScript source.

commands.name: get_console_log
commands.description: Returns the newest structured browser preview and editor console entries.

commands.name: get_debug_context
commands.description: Returns a compact AI debugging starting point for the active project: current revision state, recent errors and console entries, recent changes, the nearest prior validation-valid history state, selected export preset, and recommended follow-up tool calls. It never changes editor state.

commands.name: get_errors
commands.description: Returns structured validation, preview, runtime, file, export, MCP, and recovery errors recorded by PageRivet. Machine-specific paths and credentials are redacted from diagnostic text.

commands.name: get_history
commands.description: Returns the active project's history timeline and current undo/redo position.

commands.name: get_history_diff
commands.description: Returns a line diff between two active-project history snapshots. If IDs are omitted, compares the current snapshot with its predecessor.

commands.name: get_recent_changes
commands.description: Returns the newest project history snapshots, including change origin, changed files, and validation result.

commands.name: get_export_preset
commands.description: Returns the export preset currently selected for the active project, including all restrictions.

commands.name: validate_export
commands.description: Validates the applied active project against its selected export preset without creating output.

commands.name: validate_project
commands.description: Validates the applied active-project HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without modifying files or editor state.
